description: svelte-check: 'Argument of type Timeout is not assignable to parameter of number' at src/lib/stores/toast.svelte.ts:72 and :75. timeoutIds is declared Set<number> (line 15) but setTimeout returns NodeJS.Timeout under the current tsconfig typings. Fix: type as Set<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>> (robust across DOM/Node lib configs). Runtime works today only because happy-dom/vitest laxity - keep it type-clean.
title: toast.svelte.ts timer type mismatch (Timeout vs number)
